cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Supportive Rage
cards.instruction: Remain helpful and encouraging while becoming increasingly furious.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Choose the birthday lunch you really want. I'll drive.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The seaside place. We'd lose your deposit here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Forty pounds wasted. Fine. You love the sea; let's make a day of it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've booked it. They need another forty now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Another forty? Eighty pounds before a bloody sandwich. Give me the number. You're getting your sea view. Ask for a window; you deserve one.

mechanism: A authorizes a birthday choice and escalating expenditure while staying encouraging despite increasingly explicit fury.
confusable: Merely paying angrily is insufficient: continued practical help and encouragement must coexist with rank-based permission.
comparison: Birthday spending supports a desired outing rather than cleaning damage and sacrificing household possessions.
seedUse: D21-b deposits and window request supply specific pressure; S01 should make approval of B choice the form of support.
